jobs.prompt:
Delta review of release train 5 (money blocker). Round 1 failed with ONE blocker: tools/watch-assets/hive-panels.js rendered a dollar amount built with String.fromCharCode(36) ('spend recorded'), and tools/command-center-snapshot.mjs forwarded spendUsd/cost into the /api/command-center JSON, breaking the owner's no-money-in-browser rule. The fix is in coordination/review/train5-delta.diff (against the round-1 head c0b23518); the changed source and the updated tests are in context.

What changed: spendUsd removed from the project cards and machine stats in the Command Center snapshot; the Hive spend row, view.spend and all dollar/fromCharCode construction removed; the Cockpit Classic tab now points at /classic with the search string; tests/board-no-money.test.mjs now forbids String.fromCharCode(36); tests/command-center-routes-flag.test.mjs asserts the API bodies carry no usd/spend/cost keys or values for a fixture that has them; tests/command-center-hive.test.mjs drops the spend expectations.

Pass bar (owner): confirm the round-1 blocker is CLOSED for each facet (API money, rendered money, obfuscated dollar, Cockpit classic reachability, the new test coverage) and there is no NEW blocker: a layout/data regression in the Hive panels, an API consumer left reading spendUsd, a money value still reachable in the Command Center JSON, a broken classic route, or a test weakened. Everything else is a follow-up. The runner stamps the reviewed head into your result; do NOT add or change a head field. Write ONLY coordination/review/train5-review.json: {"verdict":"pass"|"fail","score":0-10,"blockers":[{"file":"","line":0,"problem":"","exploit_or_failure":"","fix":""}],"followups":[same shape],"summary":""}. verdict is fail only if blockers is non-empty.
